description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Mental Mutation

You develop an idolised and grandiose self-image. You are vain, arrogant and prickly. Success is due to your involvement, failure is blamed on others. Criticism, disagreements and perceived slights are taken as personal attacks. You gain +10 on all social Tests that aim to put you in the centre of attention, claim glory or deflect criticism. You gain -10 on all Tests that would assist someone else in achieving glory and attention, or that would make you appear humble. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.x8g3U68oi8XzWiYr]{Commanding Presence} Talent.
